title: ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT
subcategoryTitle: 大型望遠鏡與重力波觀測站
summary: 以 Cerro Armazones 上的 39 m ELT 為對象，從繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度出發，拆解五鏡設計、798 片六角鏡段的 133 種段型與 8 nm 拋光、六片 1.95 mm 薄殼組成的 M4、約 9000 個邊緣感測器的共相控制、M4／M5 的頻段分工，以及分段重鍍與初光驗收的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Taking the 39 m ELT on Cerro Armazones, start from the diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity, then work through the five-mirror design, the 133 segment types and 8 nm polish of 798 hexagonal segments, the M4 built from six 1.95 mm shells, phasing control with about 9000 edge sensors, the M4/M5 frequency split, and the engineering logic of segment recoating and first-light acceptance.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度」與「五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture" and "Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “39 m segmented aperture” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ELT 的科學理由不只是集光：當自適應光學把影像修正到接近繞射極限時，點源影像的角大小隨 λ/D 縮小，背景只在更小的立體角內與訊號競爭，因此在背景主導的條件下，達到相同訊雜比所需時間按 D⁴ 縮短，其中 D² 來自集光、另一個 D² 來自影像面積縮小。這也意味著 ELT 的價值高度依賴自適應光學與分段共相：若影像只有視寧度寬度，就只剩 D² 的集光收益。主鏡外徑 39 m、中央遮擋約 11 m，集光面積接近 1000 m²。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The scientific case for the ELT is not only light grasp: once adaptive optics brings images close to the diffraction limit, a point-source image shrinks as λ/D and the background competes with the signal over a much smaller solid angle, so in the background-limited regime the time to reach a given signal-to-noise ratio falls as D⁴, with D² from collecting area and another D² from the smaller image. It follows that the ELT's value depends heavily on adaptive optics and segment phasing: with seeing-limited images only the D² gain from area remains. The primary is 39 m across with a central obstruction of about 11 m, giving a collecting area close to 1000 m². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “39 m segmented aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：K 波段（2.2 µm）繞射極限 1.22λ/D：D = 39 m 時約 14.2 mas，8.2 m 時約 67.5 mas。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The K-band (2.2 µm) diffraction limit 1.22λ/D is about 14.2 mas for D = 39 m and 67.5 mas for 8.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “39 m segmented aperture”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT」的「39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: mechanism and system boundary” in “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture" is correct?
options: 望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。
ELT 的科學理由不只是集光：當自適應光學把影像修正到接近繞射極限時，點源影像的角大小隨 λ/D 縮小，背景只在更小的立體角內與訊號競爭，因此在背景主導的條件下，達到相同訊雜比所需時間按 D⁴ 縮短，其中 D² 來自集光、另一個 D² 來自影像面積縮小。
鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。
optionsEn: Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area.

The scientific case for the ELT is not only light grasp: once adaptive optics brings images close to the diffraction limit, a point-source image shrinks as λ/D and the background competes with the signal over a much smaller solid angle, so in the background-limited regime the time to reach a given signal-to-noise ratio falls as D⁴, with D² from collecting area and another D² from the smaller image.
Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building.
quiz.explanation: ELT 的科學理由不只是集光：當自適應光學把影像修正到接近繞射極限時，點源影像的角大小隨 λ/D 縮小，背景只在更小的立體角內與訊號競爭，因此在背景主導的條件下，達到相同訊雜比所需時間按 D⁴ 縮短，其中 D² 來自集光、另一個 D² 來自影像面積縮小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The scientific case for the ELT is not only light grasp: once adaptive optics brings images close to the diffraction limit, a point-source image shrinks as λ/D and the background competes with the signal over a much smaller solid angle, so in the background-limited regime the time to reach a given signal-to-noise ratio falls as D⁴, with D² from collecting area and another D² from the smaller image. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “39 m segmented aperture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：K 波段（2.2 µm）繞射極限 1.22λ/D：D = 39 m 時約 14.2 mas，8.2 m 時約 67.5 mas。背景主導且繞射受限時，所需時間比 ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512；只有集光時為 (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6。以外半徑 18.5 m、內半徑 5.5 m 估算面積 π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m²，遮擋佔外圓面積約 (11.1/39)² ≈ 8%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The K-band (2.2 µm) diffraction limit 1.22λ/D is about 14.2 mas for D = 39 m and 67.5 mas for 8.2 m. Background-limited and diffraction-limited, the time ratio is ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512, versus (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6 from area alone. With outer radius 18.5 m and inner radius 5.5 m the area is π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m², and the obstruction covers about (11.1/39)² ≈ 8% of the outer disc. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立；並把結果與單元望遠鏡的實測曝光時間計算器比較，作為科學需求與自適應光學需求的連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl; compare against exposure-time calculators of existing 8 m telescopes to link science requirements with adaptive-optics requirements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: K 波段（2.2 µm）繞射極限 1.22λ/D：D = 39 m 時約 14.2 mas，8.2 m 時約 67.5 mas。背景主導且繞射受限時，所需時間比 ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512；只有集光時為 (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6。以外半徑 18.5 m、內半徑 5.5 m 估算面積 π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m²，遮擋佔外圓面積約 (11.1/39)² ≈ 8%。
knowledge.textEn: The K-band (2.2 µm) diffraction limit 1.22λ/D is about 14.2 mas for D = 39 m and 67.5 mas for 8.2 m. Background-limited and diffraction-limited, the time ratio is ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512, versus (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6 from area alone. With outer radius 18.5 m and inner radius 5.5 m the area is π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m², and the obstruction covers about (11.1/39)² ≈ 8% of the outer disc.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture", which statement holds?
options: 自適應鏡越硬越好，因為剛性才能保持形狀。
只要自適應鏡夠快，望遠鏡結構振動就不需要另外管理。
K 波段（2.2 µm）繞射極限 1.22λ/D：D = 39 m 時約 14.2 mas，8.2 m 時約 67.5 mas。
optionsEn: An adaptive mirror should be as stiff as possible because stiffness holds shape.
If the adaptive mirror is fast enough, structural vibration needs no separate management.
The K-band (2.2 µm) diffraction limit 1.22λ/D is about 14.2 mas for D = 39 m and 67.5 mas for 8.2 m.
quiz.explanation: K 波段（2.2 µm）繞射極限 1.22λ/D：D = 39 m 時約 14.2 mas，8.2 m 時約 67.5 mas。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The K-band (2.2 µm) diffraction limit 1.22λ/D is about 14.2 mas for D = 39 m and 67.5 mas for 8.2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “39 m segmented aperture” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立；並把結果與單元望遠鏡的實測曝光時間計算器比較，作為科學需求與自適應光學需求的連結。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl; compare against exposure-time calculators of existing 8 m telescopes to link science requirements with adaptive-optics requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若專案只追求主鏡面積而低估共相與自適應光學的難度，完成的望遠鏡會變成昂貴的視寧度受限光桶，在背景主導的紅外觀測中只得到約 23 倍而非數百倍的時間收益。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a project chases mirror area while underestimating phasing and adaptive optics, the finished telescope becomes an expensive seeing-limited light bucket that gains only about 23 times, not hundreds of times, in background-limited infrared observing time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立；並把結果與單元望遠鏡的實測曝光時間計算器比較，作為科學需求與自適應光學需求的連結。
knowledge.textEn: Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl; compare against exposure-time calculators of existing 8 m telescopes to link science requirements with adaptive-optics requirements.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture"?
options: 以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
分段主鏡可以像單片主鏡一樣，幾年才一次整面重鍍。
optionsEn: Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A segmented primary can be recoated all at once every few years like a monolithic one.
quiz.explanation: 以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立；並把結果與單元望遠鏡的實測曝光時間計算器比較，作為科學需求與自適應光學需求的連結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl; compare against exposure-time calculators of existing 8 m telescopes to link science requirements with adaptive-optics requirements. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “39 m segmented aperture” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若專案只追求主鏡面積而低估共相與自適應光學的難度，完成的望遠鏡會變成昂貴的視寧度受限光桶，在背景主導的紅外觀測中只得到約 23 倍而非數百倍的時間收益。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a project chases mirror area while underestimating phasing and adaptive optics, the finished telescope becomes an expensive seeing-limited light bucket that gains only about 23 times, not hundreds of times, in background-limited infrared observing time. steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ELT 的光學由五面鏡組成：M1 為曲率半徑約 68.7 m 的 39 m 分段凹面橢球鏡，M2 為 4.2 m 凸面薄彎月鏡，M3 為 3.8 m 主動凹面鏡，三者構成在較大視場內同時校正球差、彗差與像散的三鏡消像散系統。M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，修正大氣湍流與望遠鏡振動；M5 是約 2.6 m × 2.1 m 的平面橢圓鏡，負責數 Hz 以下的影像穩定並把光送到 Nasmyth 平台。把自適應鏡做在望遠鏡內，所有儀器都能共用修正，但也代表每多一面鏡就多一次反射損失與熱發射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: ELT optics consist of five mirrors: M1 is a 39 m segmented concave ellipsoid with a radius of curvature of about 68.7 m, M2 a 4.2 m convex thin meniscus and M3 a 3.8 m active concave mirror, together forming a three-mirror anastigmat that corrects spherical aberration, coma and astigmatism over a wide field. M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across that corrects atmospheric turbulence and telescope vibration; M5 is a flat elliptical mirror of about 2.6 m × 2.1 m that stabilises the image below a few hertz and sends the beam to the Nasmyth platforms. Building the adaptive mirror into the telescope lets every instrument share the correction, but each extra mirror adds a reflection loss and thermal emission. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “M1 to M5 five-mirror train”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：五次反射的通量為 R⁵：每面 R = 0.95（假設）時 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774，R = 0.97 時 ≈ 0.859，差異相當於 11% 的曝光時間。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Five reflections give a throughput of R⁵: 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774 with R = 0.95 per mirror (assumption) and ≈ 0.859 with R = 0.97, a difference worth 11% of exposure time.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “M1 to M5 five-mirror train”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：五次反射的通量為 R⁵：每面 R = 0.95（假設）時 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774，R = 0.97 時 ≈ 0.859，差異相當於 11% 的曝光時間。M1 的曲率半徑 68.7 m 對應焦距約 34.4 m，主鏡邊緣的光線傾角 r/R = 18.5/68.7 ≈ 0.27 rad（約 15°），顯示 M1 是非常快的分段鏡面。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Five reflections give a throughput of R⁵: 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774 with R = 0.95 per mirror (assumption) and ≈ 0.859 with R = 0.97, a difference worth 11% of exposure time. M1's 68.7 m radius of curvature gives a focal length of about 34.4 m, and the surface slope at the rim r/R = 18.5/68.7 ≈ 0.27 rad (about 15°) shows how fast the segmented primary is. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光學設計軟體建立五鏡模型，對每面鏡的位移與傾斜計算 Zernike 靈敏度矩陣，確認 M2 與 M3 的主動定位範圍足以涵蓋重力與溫度變形；在整合階段以內部光源與波前感測器量測系統像差，並以分項反射率乘積與實測天文通量比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the five-mirror model in optical-design software and compute the Zernike sensitivity matrix for displacement and tilt of each mirror, confirming that the active positioning ranges of M2 and M3 cover gravity and thermal deformation; during integration measure system aberrations with internal sources and wavefront sensors, and compare the product of individual reflectances with measured on-sky throughput.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

M1's 68.7 m radius of curvature gives a focal length of about 34.4 m, and the surface slope at the rim r/R = 18.5/68.7 ≈ 0.27 rad (about 15°) shows how fast the segmented primary is.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光學設計軟體建立五鏡模型，對每面鏡的位移與傾斜計算 Zernike 靈敏度矩陣，確認 M2 與 M3 的主動定位範圍足以涵蓋重力與溫度變形；在整合階段以內部光源與波前感測器量測系統像差，並以分項反射率乘積與實測天文通量比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the five-mirror model in optical-design software and compute the Zernike sensitivity matrix for displacement and tilt of each mirror, confirming that the active positioning ranges of M2 and M3 cover gravity and thermal deformation; during integration measure system aberrations with internal sources and wavefront sensors, and compare the product of individual reflectances with measured on-sky throughput. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：M2 若因重力或溫度產生微小橫移，會在整個視場引入彗差，若誤由 M4 吸收，M4 的行程被常態偏置占用而失去修正湍流的餘量；M5 的低頻任務若交給 M4，也會造成同樣的行程飽和。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A small lateral shift of M2 from gravity or temperature introduces coma across the field; if M4 absorbs it, part of M4's stroke is permanently biased and its margin for turbulence shrinks, and handing M5's low-frequency job to M4 saturates its stroke in the same way.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以光學設計軟體建立五鏡模型，對每面鏡的位移與傾斜計算 Zernike 靈敏度矩陣，確認 M2 與 M3 的主動定位範圍足以涵蓋重力與溫度變形；在整合階段以內部光源與波前感測器量測系統像差，並以分項反射率乘積與實測天文通量比較。
knowledge.textEn: Build the five-mirror model in optical-design software and compute the Zernike sensitivity matrix for displacement and tilt of each mirror, confirming that the active positioning ranges of M2 and M3 cover gravity and thermal deformation; during integration measure system aberrations with internal sources and wavefront sensors, and compare the product of individual reflectances with measured on-sky throughput.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

A visibly smaller star image proves the telescope meets its design Strehl.
quiz.explanation: 以光學設計軟體建立五鏡模型，對每面鏡的位移與傾斜計算 Zernike 靈敏度矩陣，確認 M2 與 M3 的主動定位範圍足以涵蓋重力與溫度變形；在整合階段以內部光源與波前感測器量測系統像差，並以分項反射率乘積與實測天文通量比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the five-mirror model in optical-design software and compute the Zernike sensitivity matrix for displacement and tilt of each mirror, confirming that the active positioning ranges of M2 and M3 cover gravity and thermal deformation; during integration measure system aberrations with internal sources and wavefront sensors, and compare the product of individual reflectances with measured on-sky throughput. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: M2 若因重力或溫度產生微小橫移，會在整個視場引入彗差，若誤由 M4 吸收，M4 的行程被常態偏置占用而失去修正湍流的餘量；M5 的低頻任務若交給 M4，也會造成同樣的行程飽和。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A small lateral shift of M2 from gravity or temperature introduces coma across the field; if M4 absorbs it, part of M4's stroke is permanently biased and its margin for turbulence shrinks, and handing M5's low-frequency job to M4 saturates its stroke in the same way. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把自適應鏡做在望遠鏡內，所有儀器都能共用修正，但也代表每多一面鏡就多一次反射損失與熱發射。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Building the adaptive mirror into the telescope lets every instrument share the correction, but each extra mirror adds a reflection loss and thermal emission.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
